sentiment.rationale: This is a pre-earnings digest, so the guidance-change framework does not apply. Instead, the document describes elevated market uncertainty and a demanding bar: options markets priced a ~7% possible swing either direction, signaling real market uncertainty, and coverage was dominated by a major M&A overhang (the pending ~$82.7B acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery), not typical subscriber-growth-driven coverage. This suggests stretched expectations and a higher risk of a negative surprise, warranting a mildly bearish score.
